label: Guard
description: Runtime type guards (`isString`, `isArray`, `isDefined`, `isNull`, …) — narrowing functions that return boolean predicates usable in TypeScript type-safe branches. The `isTemporal*` guards recognize Temporal objects, which only exist on Node.js 26+ and recent Chrome/Firefox/Edge; Safari has no stable Temporal yet (WebKit signals late 2026), so load a Temporal polyfill there.
